descriptions.w3d_d24h_jetpack_part_800ae7d4: Jetpack part effect state: resolves the owner of +32 (0x80343584) and the model global for part 0, 1 or 2. State 0 posts a 12-byte message with the current effect handle when one is active and clears the part's handle (+52) and state (+64). State 1 stops the running effect recursively and spawns Part_JetpackSmokeTrail (0x800e5cf0). State 2 stops it and spawns Jetpack_directional for part 2 or Part_Jetpack otherwise. Other parts or states do nothing.
